name: cinematic
what: Soundtrack production from Secret Agent Rendezvous (docs/demo_study): no pump at all (its loudest section swings 1.2 dB), swells and one hit instead of risers, a beat of silence before the big entrance, a reverb throw out of each cue, and an ending that stops on a hit. Meter and tempo changes are by hand (form.cinematic_cues).
section_gains_how: Not applied blind: after the first render read measure_section_levels' contrast and run apply_section_gains with by_role {'scale': x}, aiming from the measured slope (tools/remix_song.py does this).
